translations.text: Se acabó el tiempo. La barra ha bajado: las bolas que caigan ya no vuelven. Sigues jugando con las blancas que quedan en la bandeja, y la partida termina cuando juegues la última.

translations.key: Time is up. The bar is down: balls that drop now stay down. You play on with the whites left in the tray, and the game ends once the last one has been played.
translations.text: Le temps est écoulé. La barre est baissée : les billes qui tombent restent dedans. Tu continues avec les blanches qui restent dans le bac, et la partie se termine une fois la dernière jouée.

translations.key: Time is up. The bar is down: balls that drop now stay down. You play on with the whites left in the tray, and the game ends once the last one has been played.
translations.text: Die Zeit ist um. Die Sperre ist unten: Kugeln, die jetzt fallen, bleiben unten. Du spielst mit den Weißen weiter, die noch in der Rinne liegen, und das Spiel endet, sobald die letzte gespielt ist.

translations.key: Time is up. The bar is down: balls that drop now stay down. You play on with the whites left in the tray, and the game ends once the last one has been played.
translations.text: Il tempo è scaduto. La barra è abbassata: le bilie che cadono ora restano giù. Continui con le bianche rimaste nel vassoio, e la partita finisce quando hai giocato l’ultima.

translations.key: Time is up. The bar is down: balls that drop now stay down. You play on with the whites left in the tray, and the game ends once the last one has been played.

translations.key: Time is up. The bar is down: balls that drop now stay down. You play on with the whites left in the tray, and the game ends once the last one has been played.
translations.text: 時間切れ。バーが下りた：これから落ちた球は戻らない。トレイに残った白球で続けて、最後の1個を突いたらゲーム終了。

translations.key: Time is up. The bar is down: balls that drop now stay down. You play on with the whites left in the tray, and the game ends once the last one has been played.
translations.text: 시간이 다 됐어. 바가 내려갔어: 이제 떨어지는 공은 돌아오지 않아. 트레이에 남은 흰 공으로 계속하고, 마지막 공을 치면 게임이 끝나.

translations.key: Time is up. The bar is down: balls that drop now stay down. You play on with the whites left in the tray, and the game ends once the last one has been played.
translations.text: 时间到。挡杆已落下：现在落洞的球不再返回。用球槽里剩下的白球继续打，最后一个打完比赛就结束。

translations.key: Time is up. The bar is down: balls that drop now stay down. You play on with the whites left in the tray, and the game ends once the last one has been played.
translations.text: Время вышло. Планка опущена: упавшие шары больше не возвращаются. Играешь белыми, что остались в лотке, и игра закончится, когда сыграешь последний.

translations.key: Time is up. The bar is down: balls that drop now stay down. You play on with the whites left in the tray, and the game ends once the last one has been played.
translations.text: انتهى الوقت. نزل الحاجز: الكرات التي تسقط الآن تبقى في الأسفل. تواصل اللعب بالكرات البيضاء الباقية في الصينية، وتنتهي اللعبة بعد أن تلعب آخرها.

translations.key: Two players, five balls each: white for the first player, red for the second. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the other player does.
translations.text: Dos jugadores, cinco bolas cada uno: blancas para el primero, rojas para el segundo. Mete tus cinco bolas en la copa del extremo opuesto a donde empezaron, antes que el otro jugador.

translations.key: Two players, five balls each: white for the first player, red for the second. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the other player does.
translations.text: Deux joueurs, cinq billes chacun : les blanches pour le premier, les rouges pour le second. Rentre tes cinq billes dans le trou à l’autre bout de leur départ, avant l’autre joueur.

translations.key: Two players, five balls each: white for the first player, red for the second. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the other player does.
translations.text: Zwei Spieler, je fünf Kugeln: Weiß für den ersten, Rot für den zweiten. Versenke alle fünf deiner Kugeln im Loch am anderen Ende ihres Startplatzes, bevor der andere es schafft.

translations.key: Two players, five balls each: white for the first player, red for the second. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the other player does.
translations.text: Due giocatori, cinque bilie a testa: bianche per il primo, rosse per il secondo. Imbuca tutte e cinque le tue nella buca all’estremità opposta a dove sono partite, prima dell’altro giocatore.

translations.key: Two players, five balls each: white for the first player, red for the second. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the other player does.
translations.text: Dois jogadores, cinco bolas cada um: brancas para o primeiro, vermelhas para o segundo. Mete as tuas cinco no buraco do lado oposto ao de onde partiram, antes do outro jogador.

translations.key: Two players, five balls each: white for the first player, red for the second. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the other player does.
translations.text: Dois jogadores, cinco bolas cada um: brancas para o primeiro, vermelhas para o segundo. Encaçape suas cinco no buraco do lado oposto ao de onde saíram, antes do outro jogador.

translations.key: Two players, five balls each: white for the first player, red for the second. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the other player does.
translations.text: 2人で、各自5個の球を使う。1人目は白、2人目は赤。スタート位置と反対側の穴に、相手より先に自分の5個を全部沈めよう。

translations.key: Two players, five balls each: white for the first player, red for the second. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the other player does.
translations.text: 두 사람이 각자 공 5개로 해. 첫 번째 사람은 흰 공, 두 번째 사람은 빨간 공. 상대보다 먼저, 출발한 곳 반대편 구멍에 내 공 5개를 모두 넣어.

translations.key: Two players, five balls each: white for the first player, red for the second. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the other player does.
translations.text: 两名玩家，每人五个球：先手用白球，后手用红球。抢在对方之前，把自己的五个球全部打进起点另一端的洞里。

translations.key: Two players, five balls each: white for the first player, red for the second. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the other player does.
translations.text: Два игрока, по пять шаров: белые у первого, красные у второго. Загони все свои пять в лузу на дальнем от старта конце раньше соперника.

translations.key: Two players, five balls each: white for the first player, red for the second. Sink all five of yours in the cup at the far end from where they started, before the other player does.
translations.text: لاعبان، لكل منهما خمس كرات: البيضاء للاعب الأول والحمراء للثاني. أدخل كراتك الخمس كلها في الحفرة في الطرف المقابل لمكان بدايتها، قبل اللاعب الآخر.

translations.key: You always strike one of your own balls: your marked ball, the one with a spot, while it is on the table, then your others one at a time in a fixed order. The cue is always set on the right one.
translations.text: Siempre golpeas una de tus bolas: tu bola marcada, la del punto, mientras siga en la mesa, y después las demás de una en una en un orden fijo. El taco siempre apunta a la que toca.

translations.key: You always strike one of your own balls: your marked ball, the one with a spot, while it is on the table, then your others one at a time in a fixed order. The cue is always set on the right one.
translations.text: Tu joues toujours une de tes billes : ta bille marquée, celle avec un point, tant qu’elle est sur la table, puis les autres une à une dans un ordre fixe. Ta queue est toujours posée sur la bonne.

translations.key: You always strike one of your own balls: your marked ball, the one with a spot, while it is on the table, then your others one at a time in a fixed order. The cue is always set on the right one.
translations.text: Du spielst immer eine deiner eigenen Kugeln: deine markierte, die mit dem Punkt, solange sie auf dem Tisch ist, dann die anderen einzeln in fester Reihenfolge. Dein Queue ist immer an der richtigen angesetzt.

translations.key: You always strike one of your own balls: your marked ball, the one with a spot, while it is on the table, then your others one at a time in a fixed order. The cue is always set on the right one.
translations.text: Colpisci sempre una delle tue bilie: quella segnata, con il pallino, finché è sul tavolo, poi le altre una alla volta in un ordine fisso. La stecca è sempre puntata su quella giusta.

translations.key: You always strike one of your own balls: your marked ball, the one with a spot, while it is on the table, then your others one at a time in a fixed order. The cue is always set on the right one.
translations.text: Jogas sempre uma das tuas bolas: a marcada, a que tem um ponto, enquanto estiver na mesa, depois as outras uma a uma por uma ordem fixa. O taco aponta sempre para a certa.

translations.key: You always strike one of your own balls: your marked ball, the one with a spot, while it is on the table, then your others one at a time in a fixed order. The cue is always set on the right one.
translations.text: Você sempre joga uma das suas bolas: a marcada, a que tem um ponto, enquanto estiver na mesa, depois as outras uma por vez em uma ordem fixa. O taco sempre aponta para a certa.

translations.key: You always strike one of your own balls: your marked ball, the one with a spot, while it is on the table, then your others one at a time in a fixed order. The cue is always set on the right one.
translations.text: 突くのは必ず自分の球。点の付いたマーク球が台にある間はそれを、そのあとは決まった順に1個ずつ。キューはいつも正しい球に構えてある。

translations.key: You always strike one of your own balls: your marked ball, the one with a spot, while it is on the table, then your others one at a time in a fixed order. The cue is always set on the right one.
translations.text: 항상 내 공 중 하나를 쳐. 점이 찍힌 표시된 공이 테이블에 있는 동안은 그 공을, 그다음엔 정해진 순서대로 하나씩. 큐는 항상 맞는 공을 겨누고 있어.

translations.key: You always strike one of your own balls: your marked ball, the one with a spot, while it is on the table, then your others one at a time in a fixed order. The cue is always set on the right one.
translations.text: 你总是击打自己的球：带圆点的标记球还在台上时打它，之后按固定顺序逐个打其他球。球杆总是对准该打的那个球。

translations.key: You always strike one of your own balls: your marked ball, the one with a spot, while it is on the table, then your others one at a time in a fixed order. The cue is always set on the right one.
translations.text: Ты всегда бьёшь своим шаром: отмеченным, с точкой, пока он на столе, затем остальными по одному в установленном порядке. Кий всегда наведён на нужный.

translations.key: You always strike one of your own balls: your marked ball, the one with a spot, while it is on the table, then your others one at a time in a fixed order. The cue is always set on the right one.
translations.text: تضرب دائمًا إحدى كراتك: كرتك المعلَّمة، التي عليها نقطة، ما دامت على الطاولة، ثم الباقي واحدة تلو الأخرى بترتيب ثابت. العصا مصوَّبة دائمًا على الكرة الصحيحة.

translations.key: When the clock runs out a bar drops: balls that drop stay down. You play on with the whites left in the tray; whites resting on the table stay where they are. When the last white from the tray has been played, the game ends. The clock stops while you watch a replay or the Lens.
translations.text: Cuando se acaba el tiempo baja una barra: las bolas que caen ya no vuelven. Sigues jugando con las blancas que quedan en la bandeja; las blancas que están en la mesa se quedan donde están. Cuando juegas la última blanca de la bandeja, termina la partida. El reloj se para mientras ves una repetición o la Lente.

translations.text: Quand le chrono s’arrête, une barre descend : les billes qui tombent restent dedans. Tu continues avec les blanches qui restent dans le bac ; les blanches posées sur la table restent où elles sont. Une fois la dernière blanche du bac jouée, la partie se termine. Le chrono s’arrête pendant un ralenti ou la Lentille.

translations.text: Wenn die Uhr abgelaufen ist, fällt eine Sperre: Kugeln, die fallen, bleiben unten. Du spielst mit den Weißen weiter, die noch in der Rinne liegen; Weiße, die auf dem Tisch liegen, bleiben, wo sie sind. Ist die letzte Weiße aus der Rinne gespielt, endet das Spiel. Die Uhr steht, solange du eine Wiederholung oder die Lens ansiehst.

translations.text: Quando il tempo scade scende una barra: le bilie che cadono restano giù. Continui con le bianche rimaste nel vassoio; le bianche ferme sul tavolo restano dove sono. Quando hai giocato l’ultima bianca del vassoio, la partita finisce. L’orologio si ferma mentre guardi un replay o la Lens.

translations.text: Quando o tempo acaba desce uma barra: as bolas que caem ficam lá dentro. Continuas com as brancas que restam no tabuleiro; as brancas paradas na mesa ficam onde estão. Quando jogares a última branca do tabuleiro, o jogo termina. O relógio para enquanto vês uma repetição ou a Lente.
